title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Joshua 17: Manasseh's lot, the daughters of Zelophehad, and the forest land given to Joseph's children.

questions.text: Why did Machir have Gilead and Bashan?
questions.explanation: Machir, the firstborn of Manasseh and father of Gilead, had Gilead and Bashan because he was a man of war.

answers.text: Because he asked Moses for it
Because he was a man of war

questions.text: What was unusual about Zelophehad's children?
questions.explanation: Zelophehad had no sons, but daughters.

answers.text: He had only sons and no daughters
He had twelve sons and one daughter
He had no children of his own
He had no sons, only daughters

questions.text: What were the names of Zelophehad's daughters?
questions.explanation: His daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

answers.text: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah

questions.text: To whom did Zelophehad's daughters come to ask for an inheritance?
questions.explanation: They came to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes.

answers.text: Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the princes
Moses, Aaron, and the elders of Israel
Caleb, Othniel, and the men of Judah
The elders and judges of Gilead

questions.text: How many parts fell to Manasseh besides Gilead and Bashan?
questions.explanation: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan beyond the Jordan.

questions.text: In the border description, they reached to Asher on the north and to which tribe on the east?
questions.explanation: They reached to Asher on the north and to Issachar on the east.

questions.text: What did Israel do with the Canaanites once they had grown strong?
questions.explanation: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor and did not utterly drive them out.

answers.text: They put them to forced labor

questions.text: What did the children of Joseph complain about to Joshua?
questions.explanation: They asked why Joshua had given them just one lot and one part, since they were a numerous people.

answers.text: Their land was too far from Gilgal
They had received only one lot and one part

questions.text: What did Joshua tell them to do since they were a numerous people?
questions.explanation: Joshua told them to go up to the forest and clear land for themselves in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim.

answers.text: Go back across the Jordan to Gilead
Go up to the forest and clear land for themselves
Take a share of Judah's land
Wait for another lot to be cast

questions.text: What did the Canaanites in the valley have, according to the children of Joseph?
questions.explanation: The children of Joseph said the Canaanites in the land of the valley had chariots of iron.
